### Fixed

- (gs) [Card and Edit button agree on upgrade mode on the 0.244 line](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2842) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — On a deployment's page, the About card's `Auto-upgrade` and the edit template that `Edit` pre-fills agree, e.g. `Minor and patch` for `>=5.12.0 <6.0.0`. A range that admits its upper bound's pre-releases, such as `>=1.0.0-0 <3.0.0`, keeps the custom range.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v0.246.6...v0.246.7
